correctness.rationale: Disk projections require vanishing of the two tracefree compression coordinates of Q on each plane. The diagonalize-A separation lemma is sound: dependence with a nontrivial eigenvector e forces e to be a B-eigenvector; variation within a repeated eigenspace forces B scalar on that eigenspace; three noncollinear (a_i,b_i) then yield a plane with two independent measurements, contradiction. Inductively reduce the tracefree symmetric kernel by two dimensions until zero; the nonzero analytic rank minor gives open dense full-measure tuples on connected Gr(2,n)^m. For fewer planes, dimension counting gives nonzero Q in the kernel, and 1+epsilon u^T Q u has positive spherical curvature for small epsilon, hence smooth nonball counterexamples. Independently derived measurement constraints and modular full-rank instances n=3,4,5,6,7 with D=5,9,14,20,27 and m=3,5,7,10,14. Finite ranks corroborate, not prove all n.
